title: San Gabriel Taiwanese Lions Club 美國台灣人獅子會
content_html: The San Gabriel Taiwanese Lions Club is a Taiwanese American chapter of Lions Clubs International, officially established on October 21, 1993. It is part of Zone A, Foothill Region, District 4-L2, Multiple District 4 (California and Nevada). The club engages in community service activities including blood bank support, eye bank contributions, and fundraising for those in need, with a particular focus on vision-related causes through the Campaign SightFirst initiative. The club also sponsors Leo Lions (youth) programs and student exchange programs aimed at cultural exchange and leadership development.
